items.title: Compositions of flat ring maps and flatness of modules along scalar restriction
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a composition of flat, respectively faithfully flat, ring maps is flat, respectively faithfully flat, and that a flat module over a flat extension is flat over the base (statement lines 8888-8895). The proof does not use any criterion in terms of ideals: it reduces the ring statement to the module statement, takes an exact complex, applies flatness of the ring map and then flatness of the module, and identifies the resulting complex with the one obtained directly by tensoring over the base using the canonical isomorphism of twice-extended tensor products (proof lines 8897-8922). Deciding to prove the more general module statement is what makes the argument short. H2.
